result.title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark
result.summary: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a model trained on a labelled source domain to an unlabelled target domain without access to the source data. Almost the entire SFDA literature assumes mutually exclusive classes, yet many deployed settings are multi-label. This paper formulates SFDA for multi-label classification and establishes the first benchmark for it: five adaptation tasks over six datasets spanning remote sensing, natural, clipart-style and driving imagery, with four single-label SFDA methods extended to provide the first baselines and a published multi-label method run alongside them, over three seeds. The benchmark shows that extending a single-label method is unreliable rather than merely suboptimal: half of the extended baselines fail to improve on the unadapted source model at all, and on two of the five tasks none of them does. The failures are not incidental. Nearest-centroid pseudo-labelling, softmax-based confidence, the diversity term of information maximization and confidence-weighted prototype construction each rely on mutual exclusivity, and each fails differently without it, so replacing the softmax with per-class sigmoids is a valid but insufficient extension. Multi-label Prototype Alignment with Contrastive Teaching (MPACT) is proposed in response, a mean-teacher framework whose objective, prototype construction and alignment term are each reconsidered for overlapping label sets. It attains the best average on every reported metric and is the only method that improves on the unadapted source model on all five tasks. The analysis further introduces a prototype-agreement diagnostic separating feature-space alignment from self-reinforcing agreement with the classifier, and reports a negative result for confidence-based pseudo-label filtering.

AI.brief_summary: 该文为多标签图像分类建立首个无源域适应基准，覆盖六个数据集上的五个迁移任务，将四种单标签 SFDA 方法扩展为基线，并指出最近质心伪标签、softmax 置信度与信息最大化多样性项在多标签下失效；进而提出基于 mean-teacher 的 MPACT，重新设计目标、原型构建与对齐项。
AI.relevance_reason: 文中区分「特征空间对齐」与「与分类器自我强化的一致」的原型一致性诊断，以及置信度伪标签筛选的负结果，可能为核查 latent 状态是否真正使用视觉证据、而非自我确认提供诊断思路，可供人工核查其可迁移性。
